arxiv-2002-08022.title: Properties of Prime Products and Robin’s Inequality
arxiv-2002-08022.creator: William McCann
arxiv-2002-08022.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by William McCann. There are many formulations of problems that have been proven to be equivalent to the Riemann Hypothesis in modern mathematics. In this paper we look at the formulation of an inequality derived by Robin in 1984 [ 3 ] that proves the Riemann Hypothesis true if and only if Robin’s Inequality is true for all n ≥ 5040 n\geq 5040 .

arxiv-2107-07368.title: A note on hyperopic cops and robber
arxiv-2107-07368.creator: N.E. Clarke, S. Finbow, M.E. Messinger, A. Porter
arxiv-2107-07368.description: Abstract We explore a variant of the game of Cops and Robber introduced by Bonato et al. where the robber is invisible unless outside the common neighbourhood of the cops. The hyperopic cop number is analogous to the cop number and we investigate bounds on this quantity.

arxiv-2403-16763.title: LiteBIRD Science Goals and Forecasts: Primordial Magnetic Fields
arxiv-2403-16763.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by . We present detailed forecasts for the constraints on the characteristics of primordial magnetic fields (PMFs) generated prior to recombination that will be obtained with the LiteBIRD satellite. The constraints are driven by some of the main physical effects of PMFs on the CMB anisotropies: the gravitational effects of magnetically-induced perturbations; the effects on the thermal and ionization history of the Universe; the Faraday rotation imprint on the CMB polarization spectra; and the non-Gaussianities induced in polarization anisotropies.

arxiv-2406-19569.title: On the Centralization and Regionalization of the Web
arxiv-2406-19569.creator: Gautam Akiwate, Kimberly Ruth, Rumaisa Habib, Zakir Durumeric
arxiv-2406-19569.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Gautam Akiwate, Kimberly Ruth, Rumaisa Habib, Zakir Durumeric. An updated and final version of this paper will be published in ACM SIGCOMM ’25. Please refer to and cite the SIGCOMM version of the paper. The arxiv version is now an archival version. Over the past decade, Internet centralization and its implications for both people and the resilience of the Internet has become a topic of active debate.

arxiv-2409-08230.title: Photon pair generation via down-conversion in III-V semiconductor microrings: modal dispersion and quasi-phase-matching
arxiv-2409-08230.creator: Samuel E. Fontaine, 1 Colin Vendromin, 1 Trevor J. Steiner, 2 Amirali Atrli, 1 Lillian Thiel, 3 Joshua Castro, 3 Galan Moody, 3 John Bowers, 2,3 Marco Liscidini, 4 and J. E. Sipe 1
arxiv-2409-08230.description: Abstract We explore how III-V semiconductor microring resonators can efficiently generate photon pairs and squeezed vacuum states via spontaneous parametric down-conversion by utilizing their built-in quasi phase matching and modal dispersion. We present an analytic expression for the biphoton wave function of photon pairs generated by weak pump pulses, and characterize the squeezed states that result under stronger pumping conditions.

arxiv-2412-05826.title: Doppelgangers++: Improved Visual Disambiguation with Geometric 3D Features
arxiv-2412-05826.creator: Yuanbo Xiangli, Ruojin Cai, Hanyu Chen, Jeffrey Byrne, Noah Snavely
arxiv-2412-05826.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yuanbo Xiangli, Ruojin Cai, Hanyu Chen, Jeffrey Byrne, Noah Snavely. Accurate 3D reconstruction is frequently hindered by visual aliasing, where visually similar but distinct surfaces (aka, doppelgangers ), are incorrectly matched. These spurious matches distort the structure-from-motion (SfM) process, leading to misplaced model elements and reduced accuracy. Prior efforts addressed this with CNN classifiers trained on curated datasets, but these approaches struggle to generalize across diverse real-world scenes and can require extensive parameter tuning.

arxiv-2504-00854.title: Non-smoothable curve singularities
arxiv-2504-00854.creator: Jan Stevens
arxiv-2504-00854.description: Abstract . For curves singularities all smoothing components of the deformation space have the same dimension, but there can be components of different dimensions. We are interested in the question of what the generic singularities are that appear in the fibre over a component. To this end we revisit the known examples of non-smoothable singularities and study their deformations.

arxiv-2505-18205.title: Source identification via path-wise gradient estimation.
arxiv-2505-18205.creator: Richard B. Lehoucq, Scott A. McKinley, Petr Plecháč
arxiv-2505-18205.description: Abstract . In the context of PDE-constrained optimization theory, source identification problems traditionally entail particles emerging from an unknown source distribution inside a domain, moving according to a prescribed stochastic process, e.g. Brownian motion, and then exiting through the boundary of a compact domain.

arxiv-2508-21051.title: Language Models and Logic Programs for Trustworthy Financial Reasoning
arxiv-2508-21051.creator: William Jurayj, Nils Holzenberger, Benjamin Van Durme
arxiv-2508-21051.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by William Jurayj, Nils Holzenberger, Benjamin Van Durme. According to the United States Internal Revenue Service, “the average American spends $ 270 \$270 and 13 hours filing their taxes”. Even beyond the U.S., tax filing requires complex reasoning, combining application of overlapping rules with numerical calculations. Because errors can incur costly penalties, any automated system must deliver high accuracy and auditability, making modern large language models (LLMs) poorly suited for this task.

arxiv-2509-03623.title: Revealing Fine Structure in Protoplanetary Disks with Physics Constrained Neural Fields
arxiv-2509-03623.creator: Aviad Levis, Nhan Luong, Richard Teague, Katherine. L. Bouman, Marcelo Barraza-Alfaro, Kevin Flaherty
arxiv-2509-03623.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Aviad Levis, Nhan Luong, Richard Teague, Katherine. L. Bouman, Marcelo Barraza-Alfaro, Kevin Flaherty. Protoplanetary disks are the birthplaces of planets, and resolving their three-dimensional structure is key to understanding disk evolution. The unprecedented resolution of ALMA demands modeling approaches that capture features beyond the reach of traditional methods.

arxiv-2511-01107.title: SLAP: Shortcut Learning for Abstract Planning
arxiv-2511-01107.creator: Y. Isabel Liu, Bowen Li, Benjamin Eysenbach, Tom Silver
arxiv-2511-01107.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Y. Isabel Liu, Bowen Li, Benjamin Eysenbach, Tom Silver. Long-horizon decision-making with sparse rewards and continuous states and actions remains a fundamental challenge in AI and robotics. Task and motion planning (TAMP) is a model-based framework that addresses this challenge by planning hierarchically with abstract actions (options). These options are manually defined, limiting the agent to behaviors that we as human engineers know how to program (pick, place, move).

pmc-11521889.title: Exploring the link between the pediatric exposome, respiratory health, and executive function in children: a narrative review
pmc-11521889.creator: Cecilia S. Alcala, Jamil M. Lane, Vishal Midya, Shoshannah Eggers, Robert O. Wright, Maria José Rosa
pmc-11521889.description: Asthma is a highly prevalent inflammatory condition, significantly affecting nearly six million U.S. children and impacting various facets of their developmental trajectories including neurodevelopment. Evidence supports a link between pediatric environmental exposures in two key areas: asthma and executive function (E.F.). E.F.s are a collective of higher-order cognitive processes facilitating goal-oriented behaviors. Studies also identify asthma-associated E.F. impairments in children.

pmc-12449667.title: Quality and Reliability of Adolescent Sexuality Education on Chinese Video Platforms: Sentiment-Topic Analysis and Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-12449667.creator: Lan Wang, Xiantao Shu, Jianmei Huang, Weiqian Yan, Duo Zhao, Amaryllis Mavragani, Melanie Shackleford, Song-Bin Guo
pmc-12449667.description: BackgroundAdolescence is a critical period for lifelong health, which makes access to accurate and comprehensive sexuality education essential. As video platforms become a primary source of information for adolescents, the quality of their content significantly impacts their physical and mental health.

pmc-13696570.title: Successful treatment of B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia with SET-NUP214 rearrangement using venetoclax: A first case report and literature review
pmc-13696570.creator: Gang Chen, Chao Min, Jing Xu, Jifu Zheng, Huihui Li, Zhenjiang Li
pmc-13696570.description: B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia (B-ALL) harboring the SET-NUP214 fusion constitutes an exceedingly rare and aggressive subtype. While this genetic aberration is a well-recognized hallmark of T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia (T-ALL), its clinical implications and therapeutic landscape in the B-cell lineage remain largely elusive.
